fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Gender, Family and the Depopulation Argument", "body": "Opening the members' hour, Chance and Derek lay out their shared view that media promotion of transgender celebrities confuses young people and, in Tikkuri's telling, quietly lowers the number of future families over a couple of generations. Both stress respect for adults' freedom to choose. Chance adds women he knows who fear a baby would ruin their lives, and worries about uneven birth rates between cultures. Derek argues schooling sold women and men alike a career that ends in debt and emptiness, while Chance insists nothing is more human than meeting daily needs with your family."}, {"title": "Tikkuri's Gender Unification Readings", "body": "Tikkuri reads a two-to-one theme running through several symbols. He frames the Statue of Liberty's line of sight to the World Trade Center, the twin towers as male and female, and the year 2001 as a gender unification ritual, then links Elliot Page's 2/21 birthday, the Mrs. Doubtfire character Daniel Hillard summing to 221, and Caitlyn Jenner's shared 63s. He sees the St. Louis Arch park as a womb diagram and ties the arch's June 10, 1967 inauguration to the reversing 2021 eclipses. Chance answers that true androgyny is an inner union of yin and yang."}, {"title": "The Eclipse Crucifixion Code", "body": "Derek walks through the eclipse crucifixion code he first presented at Anarchadelphia, his reading that famous deaths line up with total solar eclipses the way darkness fell at the crucifixion. He points to the 2020 eclipse whose point of greatest eclipse fell over Argentina, with Maradona summing to 67 like total solar eclipse and a run of 34s tying in Messi and the first Argentine pope. He then decodes David Prowse, the actor inside Darth Vader, through 85 and 202, and reads the two Death Stars as two moons, adding that Saturn's moon Mimas looks just like one."}, {"title": "Saturn's Numbers: 77, 93 and El", "body": "Chance notes that El is an old name for Saturn and that the Elohim can mean judges or rulers, and Derek runs with it through Ellen, whose name equals 21 like Saturn. Chance explains his view of 666 as a person cut off from spirit and 777 as the balanced, enlightened human, which makes 77 a sorcerer's number. Derek reads the Imperial March as a 93 tribute to Saturn, and after Chance raises Crowley's cherished 93, Derek adds that thelema and agape both sum to 93 in Greek and recalls Flights 77 and 93 on 9/11."}, {"title": "Organic Gematria, Vetting and Self-Rule", "body": "Chance warns listeners that the biggest channel on a subject is not always the healthiest teacher, and Derek answers that everything online should be vetted and that his own work can be checked with the tools he built. Chance argues Aquarian freedom only comes to people who set their own boundaries and govern themselves. Derek then shares organic alignments from his own life, from The Number 23 and Pi to a 337 he and Chance both carry, plus numbers in his brother's family, closing on emotion as the force that codes events and ascension as permanent."}]
